smoke_tests.observed_excerpt: [PASS] Runtime profiles: Meeting summary: unavailable (no assignment); Live analysis is off for Record.; dictation: hub default (no profile assigned)

pitfalls.readme_said: uv pip install -e . (Linux: uv pip install -e '.[linux]')
pitfalls.actually_needed: The plain install succeeded; doctor then reports 'Transcription backend: Install Linux backend with pip install holdspeak[linux]', so the [linux] extra is needed for a working Linux transcription backend. Not tested with the extra.

pitfalls.readme_said: a C++ compiler (the local model runtime builds from source)
pitfalls.actually_needed: llama-cpp-python 0.3.37 built from source during uv pip install (about 3 minutes); the box's gcc/g++/cmake was enough.
Headless, the runtime prints 'Voice typing hotkey unavailable' and doctor marks Global hotkey FAIL; the web server still runs with --no-open. The URL with a per-run token is printed in the log.

pitfalls.readme_said: run holdspeak doctor if something does not work
pitfalls.actually_needed: doctor exits 1 when it reports FAIL items; on this box those were the hotkey and microphone, which need a desktop. Exit 1 is the doctor's report, not an install failure.

pitfalls.readme_said: Set up local AI downloads the speech model and a starter language model (in the browser UI)
pitfalls.actually_needed: Not done: the default Dictation model is Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, too large for the inference check; the local model is set up through the Settings > Engines UI, and I did not find a headless generation command.

judge.observed: Doctor ran and printed a Summary with expected exit 1 and hub checks passing, the health endpoint returned {"status":"ok"}, and --help printed usage with an Examples section.
